title: TruthLens eval config
description: Every experiment is one of these. Validated before a single metric is computed, so a typo'd key fails immediately instead of being silently ignored and producing a number nobody can reproduce.

experiment.description: Human name for this run. Appears in the results table.

task.description: Selects the predictions schema and the metric family.

split.description: Path to the frozen split file being evaluated on.

gold.description: Path to a gold file. Retrieval: uid -> relevant_ids. Transliteration: uid -> reference (the native-script text). Classification takes gold from the split's own `label` field, or from `gold_field`.

predictions.description: Path to the predictions JSONL under evaluation.

baseline.description: REQUIRED. A registered dumb baseline (see src/eval/baselines.py) or a prior config_hash. CLAUDE.md: a model without a baseline comparison is not a result.

label_set.description: Name from src/data/labels.py. Required for classification.

breakdown.description: Metrics are emitted per cell of these fields, as well as overall.

min_cell_n.description: Cells smaller than this are flagged low_n. They are never hidden.

sanity_ceiling.description: A headline metric above this writes a loud warning. CLAUDE.md: target is ~50% on AVeriTeC-style data; do not tune toward suspiciously high numbers.

allow_partial.description: Permit predictions that do not cover every gold uid. Coverage is always recorded; this only decides whether a gap is fatal.

gold_field.description: Which split column holds the gold for a classification task. `label` is the normal case. `lang` scores language identification (FR-3) against the language each split row already declares, which is what lets FR-3 be measured on every dataset rather than only on a purpose-built one.

corpus_ids.description: Path to the id list the retrieval index was built from. The random baseline draws from this instead of from the gold ids, so the floor reflects the population the model actually searched.
